name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.322.0 — The worker version-control ban is now enforced, not just stated: a PreToolUse Bash hook refuses every writing verb while a worker-dispatching build step is open, reads pass; core Worker Ban section names the enforcer. 7.321.0 — The mocks provenance ledger is deleted end to end (grammar, gate, confirmation round, counts line, exclusion rows, roadmap parking-lot check and the mocks-ledger template); the scaffold tournament's race-or-skip question becomes an auto-picked skip with a veto; the roadmap brief drops its unread Risk, Design stage, Lane and Expected specs fields and the genesis brief its duplicate Journeys section; ops-ADR derive and coverage passes and the mocks legacy-status edge paragraphs are removed. 7.320.0 — The user reaches build: every seed journey opens with a job story and carries a first-run or empty beat (--mark seed-done refuses otherwise); the roadmap brief and every new spec carry a Users section that decision-lint requires (missing-users-section); build workers and the reviewer read it, the reviewer walks the flow cold; the wireframe binds structure, not looks; the unused UX research brief is retired.
